method: Two existing ordinary pictures actually inspected;current standard PMTiles andglobal Terrarium only. No archival/survey/alternate terrain research.

references.name: whole-front-2012.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected whole front with slight side,2012. Broad low dark-gray stone base,central deep rectangular entrance andclosed brown doors,low wide stairs,three receding terraces,six square front piers andfive tall reddish closed-backed recesses,heavy shallow flared gray cap andsmall raised central roof. Upper bays are recessed against stone,not a transparent open hall. Inscription,guards,flowers,potted plants,incense vessel andsite furniture are not copied. Hidden rear androof inventory is approximate.

references.name: front-oblique-2016.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected tight frontal entrance detail,2016. The local filename front-oblique-2016 is misleading:this is not a whole oroblique view. Confirms dark-gray coursed base,deep closed rectangular entrance,closed brown paired door andlow stair. A foreground flagpole partly occludes the center. Upper volume,side,rear androof are cropped andnot evidence fromthis image.
